title: FkGauntlet
description: Negates damage block from Gauntlet of BOMD.
body:
Negates damage block from Gauntlet of BOMD.

When the mod is installed, you can ignore gauntlet's hit box and damage it.

There are plans to port it to more versions in the future.

使下界铁掌的伤害格挡失效，安装该mod后，你可以无视下界铁掌的碰撞箱判定直接对它造成伤害。

未来有计划移植到更多其他的版本

(去他的下界铁掌)
